summary.headline: Broad short-vol flow is pressing against a higher front VIX curve while deferred protection remains active.
key_points: Session VIX traded 15.39-16.29 and finished near 15.67.
Signed transaction VIX delta was -82.65M and remained strongly negative after single-package and expiry leave-one-out tests.
October 17.5-18 is the main short-vol and movement-sale pivot; 22 and 25 are important call-supply levels.
November 20C/35C carried the largest current call-supply package, while December retained positive-delta correction hedges.
The main risk is absorption of confirmed short-vol inventory if the October forward accepts above 18-18.5.
summary.daily_note: Near-term carry is trying to reassert control, but early short-vol supply was absorbed while spot VIX and front forwards expanded.

leave_one_out.comment: The negative headline is broad and robust rather than dependent on one package.

levels.label: OCTOBER SHORT-VOL / MOVEMENT-SALE PIVOT
levels.interpretation: Repeated OI-confirmed synthetic-short flow and a late short straddle make 17.5-18 the primary front-vol decision zone.

notes: Prior-session OI confirmed fresh 17.5 synthetic-short inventory.

levels.label: OCTOBER 20 INVENTORY BATTLEFIELD
levels.interpretation: Large existing OI and mixed two-sided activity make 20 a transition level rather than a clean cap or hedge zone.

notes: Oct20C OI rose to approximately 396k after a large prior-session build.

levels.label: OCTOBER 22 OI-CONFIRMED CALL SUPPLY
levels.interpretation: A prior OI increase of roughly 48k confirmed substantial fresh short-call inventory, and current flow remains sell-skewed.

notes: Stress transition route passes through 22 before 25.

levels.label: OCTOBER 25 REPEATED ORDINARY-STRESS SUPPLY
levels.interpretation: Repeated call selling makes 25 a key ordinary-stress monetization zone above the 22 supply layer.

levels.label: DECEMBER DEFERRED CORRECTION HEDGE
levels.interpretation: December remains the main positive-delta deferred hedge layer through synthetic-long activity near 19 and additional call demand near 27.

events: VIX reached 16.29 despite heavy negative transaction delta
Front VIX compressed after the earlier stress expansion
October synthetic-short and upper-call supply remained active
VIX finished above the prior low-vol regime

structures.interpretation: Protection appears to migrate from November 26C into December 26C while low-VIX put sales finance the roll.

levels.label: 22 OI-CONFIRMED SUPPLY
levels.interpretation: Large prior OI growth confirmed fresh short-call inventory at 22.

levels.label: 25 REPEATED ORDINARY-STRESS SUPPLY
levels.interpretation: Repeated call selling keeps 25 as the next important supply layer above 22.

Same-side continuation of OI-confirmed synthetic-short inventory plus ordinary and upper-stress call supply.

levels.label: 35 OI-CONFIRMED TAIL SUPPLY
levels.interpretation: Prior OI growth confirmed fresh upper-tail short-call inventory and current flow continues the sale.
